description.ja: ガンプラ40周年記念！『機動戦士ガンダム』より、シャア専用ザクIIが新規造形にてHGシリーズに登場！
description.en: Gunpla 40th anniversary! From "Mobile Suit Gundam", Char's Zaku II is now available in the HG series with a new model!

description.ja: • 『機動戦士ガンダム』におけるプロポーションを最新の技術でリバイブ。
description.en: • The proportions from "Mobile Suit Gundam" have been revived using the latest technology.

description.ja: • モノアイは頭部裏側の操作リブを動かすことで可動。
description.en: • The mono-eye can be moved by moving the operating rib on the back of the head.

description.ja: • 腕は上腕部に加え前腕部も回転し、可動域を大きく確保。
description.en: • In addition to the upper arm, the forearm also rotates, ensuring a wide range of motion.

description.ja: • 腰部の可動域をさらに広げる軟質素材パーツを同梱。プラパーツと軟質素材パーツとの選択式となっている。
description.en: • Includes soft material parts that further expand the range of motion of the lower back. You can choose between plastic parts and soft material parts.

description.ja: • 付属する３種の武器は、腰部に懸架できる。
description.en: • Three types of attached weapons can be hung on the waist.

accessories.ja: 軟質素材スカートパーツ×1式
accessories.en: Soft material skirt parts x 1 set

accessories.ja: PS成形スカートパーツ×1式
accessories.en: PS molded skirt parts x 1 set
